name: Dumbbell row
notes: Single-arm supported row. Record the load of one dumbbell.

guide.setup: Support one hand and knee on a bench, with the working arm hanging under the shoulder and the torso braced.
guide.execution: Pull the dumbbell toward the hip, pause without twisting, then lower to a full stretch.
guide.cues: Keep hips square. Pull elbow toward the back pocket. Control the lowering phase.
guide.mistakes: Rotating the torso; shrugging; yanking with momentum; cutting the bottom stretch short.
